155: /// Re-anchor a failure that happened *inside* a component onto the parent's
156: /// `use ... from` declaration (issue #567).
157: ///
158: /// `loc` is `{line, column}` with no `file` (`docs/DESIGN-v1.md`), so it can
159: /// only ever mean "a position in the file the envelope names". A component's
160: /// line and column reported against the parent's path therefore points at
161: /// whatever happens to sit there — for the compose error gallery fixture, a
162: /// comment. The position now belongs to the `use` declaration, which really is
163: /// in the parent and really is the line to look at, and the component's own
164: /// path and position move into the message so nothing is lost.
165: fn component_error(
166:     path: &str,
167:     use_span: fsl_syntax::Span,
168:     error: &CoreError,
169:     verb: &str,
170: ) -> CoreError {
171:     CoreError {
172:         message: format!(
173:             "component \"{path}\" {verb} ({} at {path}:{}:{})",
174:             error.message, error.line, error.column
175:         ),
176:         line: use_span.start.line,
177:         column: use_span.start.column,
178:         // Not propagated from `error`. What this value reports is a compose-level
179:         // failure to load a component, anchored at the parent's `use`
180:         // declaration — it is not itself a name-resolution failure, and
181:         // `docs/DESIGN-v1.md` §8's repair branch for `name` ("add a declaration
182:         // or change a type") would be wrong advice at that location. The
183:         // component's own classification survives inside the message, together
184:         // with its path and position (issue 565's flag, issue 567's anchoring).
185:         name_resolution: false,
186:         // The origin's span is the `use` declaration, which really is in the
187:         // parent, so `with_source_file` stamps the parent path onto a position
188:         // that exists there. Carrying the component's span here is what let the
189:         // rendered message pair the parent's path with the component's line.
190:         origin: Some(Box::new(crate::OriginChain {
191:             id: crate::OriginId(format!(
192:                 "compose:use:{}:{}",
193:                 use_span.start.offset, use_span.end.offset
194:             )),
195:             dialect: "compose".to_owned(),
196:             primary: Some(crate::OriginSite {
197:                 source_file: None,
198:                 span: Some(use_span),
199:                 dialect: "compose".to_owned(),
200:                 declaration_path: vec!["use".to_owned(), path.to_owned()],
201:             }),
202:             secondary: Vec::new(),
203:             lowering_steps: Vec::new(),
204:             generated: false,
205:         })),
206:     }
207: }
208: 
209: fn parse_component(
210:     source: &str,
211:     path: &str,
212:     use_span: fsl_syntax::Span,
213: ) -> Result<(SurfaceSpec, Annotations), CoreError> {
214:     let parsed = parse_document(SourceFile::new(source)).map_err(|error| {
215:         component_error(path, use_span, &CoreError::from(error), "failed to parse")
216:     })?;
217:     let SurfaceDocument::Spec(spec) = parsed.surface else {
218:         return Err(error_at("compose use must reference a spec", use_span));
219:     };
220:     let spec = PredicateExpander::new(&spec)
221:         .and_then(|expander| expander.expand(spec))
222:         .map_err(|error| component_error(path, use_span, &error, "failed to lower"))?;
223:     let spec = expand_spec_domains(spec)
224:         .map_err(|error| component_error(path, use_span, &error, "failed to lower"))?;
225:     Ok((spec, parsed.annotations))
226: }
227: 
228: fn composed_kernel(
229:     name: String,
230:     items: Vec<SpecItem>,
231:     annotations: Annotations,
232:     diagnostics: Vec<Value>,
233: ) -> KernelSpec {
234:     let mut kernel = KernelSpec {
235:         spec: SurfaceSpec {
236:             name,
237:             meta: None,
238:             items,
239:         },
240:         origins: crate::OriginRegistry::default(),
241:         annotations: fsl_syntax::AnnotationRegistry::default(),
242:         projections: Vec::new(),
243:         diagnostics,
244:     };
245:     kernel.annotations.extend(crate::SPEC_TARGET, annotations);
246:     kernel
247: }
